title: Tiled exact attention

paper.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Tiled exact attention: implement tiled online-softmax attention in PyTorch with optional Triton; verify outputs and gradients before timing. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use attention-equivalence; required output: forward(q,k,v,mask=None) -> attention output. Evaluate attention_max_error (minimize). Online log-sum-exp block correction; test gradients before speed measurements. Required ablation: Compare materialized attention with tiled attention at increasing sequence lengths. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
